# Gas Recycling Gas recycling lets you return useful gases to the station's systems instead of simply venting them into space.
Waste gases are normally collected by scrubbers and sent into the waste network. They can then be filtered, separated, and returned to [textlink="gas storage" link="GasMiningAndStorage"] or used in other processes.
A well-configured recycling system reduces the consumption of freshly mined gases and helps the station endure long shifts.
Monitor the composition and temperature of recycled gas: hot or hazardous mixtures can damage the system or cause another atmospheric incident.
